details:
SPACE GRAVEYARD – Every Abandoned Machine Has a Story

SPACE GRAVEYARD is an interactive, child-friendly digital museum that brings the stories of NASA's abandoned and inactive equipment on the Moon and Mars to life.

Space missions leave behind more than footprints. They leave scientific instruments, landers, rovers, and other equipment that helped humanity explore distant worlds. Our project transforms these forgotten machines into an engaging learning experience for children and space enthusiasts.

The website features:

  • Interactive Moon and Mars Exhibits: Explore historical NASA missions and discover equipment left behind on other worlds.
  • Chandu's Story: A fictional, child-friendly storytelling experience that explains the Apollo 11 Moon landing through an engaging adventure.
  • Mini-Games: Educational games such as Land the Eagle, Repair the Rover, and Mission Memory Match make learning interactive.
  • Mission Exploration: Discover the stories and achievements of machines like Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, and Ingenuity.
  • NASA Sources: Explore references and learn more through original NASA information.

Technology Used: HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. The project is developed as a responsive, standalone web application and hosted using GitHub Pages.

Creativity and Impact: Instead of presenting abandoned equipment as forgotten objects, we give each machine a story. By combining storytelling, exploration, and educational games, SPACE GRAVEYARD encourages children to understand space exploration, scientific achievements, and the importance of every mission—even after it ends.

Our mission is simple: Every machine has a story, and every story deserves to be remembered.
